title: Tracing the Migration Map & Time View
style: Warm, clear archival museum narrator at a calm, unhurried pace.

steps.title: Play migration routes and filter historical eras
steps.posterAlt: Migration Map charting Lincoln and Todd settlement stops from Massachusetts and Virginia to Kentucky and Illinois.

cues.text: Open the Migration Map to follow documented family movement across towns and states.
Filter by an individual or historical era, then press Play Route to step chronologically through every geocoded stop.

steps.title: Scrub historical years on the Time view
steps.posterAlt: Time view set to 1860 showing Lincoln and Todd relatives alive in that year grouped by town.

cues.text: Open Time and drag the year slider or select a milestone year such as 1860 to see everyone alive at that moment.
Kinloom calculates each relative's age and location alongside contemporaneous local and wider historical notices.
